checks.claim: no future candle enters a signal
checks.mechanism: causal indicators (EMA/ATR/ADX/Donchian-shifted/SMA); signals evaluated per closed bar i using rows 0..i; entry at open of bar >= i+1

checks.claim: no future spread enters an earlier trade
checks.mechanism: per-bar spread array indexed by the trade's own entry/exit bars only; stress multipliers applied bar-wise

checks.claim: no future ATR enters an earlier signal
checks.mechanism: Wilder ATR is causal; trailing uses entry-bar ATR fixed per trade

checks.claim: no future EMA values are used
checks.mechanism: pandas ewm causal; HTF EMA mapped via merge_asof on fully-closed HTF bar ends only

checks.claim: no OOS data enters parameter selection
checks.mechanism: parameters frozen in research/config.py before execution; freeze receipt hashes config before OOS slice is built
